STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3

(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing) -> u3
(u0, siren_ringing & switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, siren_ringing & !switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, at_exit) -> u3
(u2, else) -> u2
(u3, else) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing, u3) -> 1.0
(u0, siren_ringing & switch_toggled, u2) -> 0.1
(u1, switch_toggled, u2) -> 0.1
(u2, at_exit, u3) -> 1.0
feedback: Sound candidate; accepted. The four-state structure u0 (no ring yet) / u1 (ring observed, not yet flipped) / u2 (flipped at least once during a ring) / u3 (exit completed) faithfully encodes 'reach the exit, and flip the switch at least once if the siren rings'. Key correctness points verified: (1) a toggle that silences a ringing siren has siren_ringing false post-step, and it is correctly captured by u1's plain switch_toggled guard rather than a siren_ringing&switch_toggled guard, so the discharge path is never lost; (2) the coincident case (toggle on the very step the first ring fires, action before due events, both labels true) is handled by the u0 guard and credited once; (3) exit from u1 (siren rang, never flipped) falls to else and pays 0, matching the unfulfilled conditional obligation, while exit pays 1.0 from u0 with !siren_ringing (needed for no-siren setups, where it is the only completion path) and from u2 regardless of later re-rings, matching 'at least once'; (4) no regressions are required by the task and none are present; u2 absorbing further toggles and re-rings also prevents farming of the 0.1 milestone, so total reward is bounded at 1.1 with a nonzero mid-episode signal in siren setups; (5) irrelevant events (box_fell, holding_box, silent toggles, any box activity) are absorbed by else self-loops in all four states, every state-action is covered, and explicit guards within each state are mutually exclusive so transition ordering is immaterial; (6) guards use only the five declared propositions with correct event/persistent usage; (7) FINAL_STATES is present and nonempty, u3 is declared and is the only accepting state, entered exactly on task completion and never rewarding thereafter; (8) every REWARD_FUNCTION entry matches a declared transition and format follows the paper template. Minor interpretation notes, not defects: a toggle before the siren's first ring earns nothing and does not discharge the obligation (the flip must occur while a ring is active or at the coincident step), which matches the natural reading that the flip responds to the ringing; and the flat 1.0 completion reward (rather than the environment's 1 - 0.9*frac schedule) is an acceptable RM design choice for this task.
